title: Inventory every kernel, capability and physical test target
requires: Any development host; access to current API, schedule and qualification records
scope: Create the machine-readable obligations manifest mapping all shared kernel entrypoints and compiled variants to domains, modes, public cases and registered physical device/backend tuples. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Enumerate kernels from build manifests, including spatial primitives, auxiliary/paint and coupling kernels, and map each applicable target to an execution test and owner.

Record real device availability, OS/GPU/driver/toolchain identifiers and current capability exclusions; include Pixel 7, available Windows CUDA/D3D12, Linux CUDA/Vulkan and macOS/iOS Metal targets without inventing hardware availability.

Add separate bounded qualification cards for additional device tuples: each depends on F8-22 and becomes a dependency of F8-99, never the reverse. Unavailable hardware and unsupported modes never become passing coverage.
Account for existing live P3-02, P1-59 and F5-99 work and handoff boundaries; archive old evidence without assigning it to the new solver.
